evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette all read instantly as a cross-hilted longsword (pointed tip, upturned guard, ringed grip, disc pommel); top view is the expected thin guard bar with blade section; A15 X/Y error 0.0, no lopsided outline.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: long blade is the big mass, guard and pommel the medium shapes, fuller, raised guard boss, gem and gold/teal wrap bands the small detail; the blade itself is a long plain run with only the fuller for interest.
evidence.V3: Proportions are close to a stock realistic longsword: long narrow blade over a short guard (2.37 x 6.81 studs) and a squat flat disc pommel that reads like a stand base; only the chunky guard and ringed grip push toward the stylised kit look, unlike the confident exaggeration of the pass anchor.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on guard arms/boss, blade edges, fuller walls and pommel rims; light catches the bevel highlights evenly in every studio close-up, no razor edges.
evidence.V5: Studio and flat close-ups of guard, blade mid, tip and pommel show smooth shading, clean fuller convergence at the tip, no pinches, seams or z-fighting; gates A17/A18 pass, 0 self-intersections, 0 cap overlaps, 0 flipped faces.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: gold accent, two steel greys, one teal hue in wrap and gem; colourways swap only the accent hue (crimson, shadow) cleanly with good value contrast.
evidence.V7: 2424 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000), at target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/steel/teal palette, ~kit chamfer width and smooth shading; guard and grip language match the kit sword family.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Tool Handle, origin at grip point, Hull collision, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, all correct.

artifacts: Pommel disc rim shows visible polygon segments on its outline in the pommel close-up (minor, silhouette faceting rather than shading)
Gem is low-poly faceted (reads as intentional cut)
top_fixes: Rework the pommel: a larger ball, lobed or wheel pommel instead of the squat flat disc so the bottom reads as a weapon end, not a stand base, and raise its rim segment count
Push stylised proportion: widen the guard span and exaggerate its upturn, or add a slight blade taper/flare near the ricasso so the long blade is not a plain straight run
Differentiate the guard from the existing paddle-crossguard-with-gem sword in the kit (e.g. quillon terminals or a distinct boss shape) so the longsword has its own identity
